```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| message: false





# ============================================================================
# STOCK SCREENER — Pullback to 10SMA Setup
# Add this chunk to your .qmd file as a new tab
# ============================================================================

# --- 1. LOAD LIBRARIES -------------------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(gt)
library(scales)

# --- 2. LOAD DATA ------------------------------------------------------------
# Adjust path if your qmd is in a different location relative to data/
universe <- read_csv("data/Universe.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# --- 3. CLEAN & TYPE-CAST ----------------------------------------------------
universe <- universe %>%
  mutate(
    `RS Rating` = as.numeric(`RS Rating`),
    `RS 3-Month Rating` = as.numeric(`RS 3-Month Rating`),
    `RS 6-Month Rating` = as.numeric(`RS 6-Month Rating`),
    `Comp Rating` = as.numeric(`Comp Rating`),
    `Price vs 21-Day` = as.numeric(`Price vs 21-Day`),
    `Price vs 50-Day` = as.numeric(`Price vs 50-Day`),
    `Price vs 200-Day` = as.numeric(`Price vs 200-Day`),
    `Price vs 10-Day` = as.numeric(`Price vs 10-Day`),
    `Price vs 150-Day` = as.numeric(`Price vs 150-Day`),
    `% Off High` = as.numeric(`% Off High`),
    `% Chg 3 Months` = as.numeric(`% Chg 3 Months`),
    `% Chg 6 Months` = as.numeric(`% Chg 6 Months`),
    `% Chg YTD` = as.numeric(`% Chg YTD`),
    `EPS Rating` = as.numeric(`EPS Rating`),
    `EPS % Chg Last Qtr` = as.numeric(`EPS % Chg Last Qtr`),
    `EPS Est Cur Yr %` = as.numeric(`EPS Est Cur Yr %`),
    `Market Cap (mil)` = as.numeric(`Market Cap (mil)`),
    `Volume (1000s)` = as.numeric(`Volume (1000s)`),
    `50-Day Avg Vol (1000s)` = as.numeric(`50-Day Avg Vol (1000s)`),
    `Weekly Closing Range` = as.numeric(`Weekly Closing Range`),
    `Ind Group Rank` = as.numeric(`Ind Group Rank`),
    `52-Wk High` = as.numeric(`52-Wk High`),
    `Current Price` = as.numeric(`Current Price`)
  )

# --- 4. SECTOR THEME ANALYSIS (Hot Sectors) ----------------------------------
sector_theme <- universe %>%
  filter(Sector != "ETF/ETN/CEF", !is.na(Sector)) %>%
  group_by(Sector) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Avg_RS_3M = round(mean(`RS 3-Month Rating`, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Avg_RS_6M = round(mean(`RS 6-Month Rating`, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Avg_3M_Chg = round(mean(`% Chg 3 Months`, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Avg_YTD_Chg = round(mean(`% Chg YTD`, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Avg_vs200D = round(mean(`Price vs 200-Day`, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Avg_RS_3M))

# --- 5. BASE FILTERS (Non-Negotiable) ----------------------------------------
base_filtered <- universe %>%
  filter(
    Sector != "ETF/ETN/CEF",
    !is.na(Sector),
    `Price vs 21-Day` > 0,
    `Price vs 50-Day` > 0,
    `Price vs 200-Day` > 0,
    `10 Day > 21 Day > 50 Day` == "Yes",
    `50-Day > 150-Day > 200-Day` == "Yes",
    `RS Rating` >= 80,
    `RS 3-Month Rating` >= 75,
    `Comp Rating` >= 80,
    `% Chg 3 Months` > 10,
    `% Chg 6 Months` > 10,
    `% Off High` > -15,
    `% Off High` < -1,
    `A/D Rating` %in% c("A+", "A", "A-", "B+", "B"),
    `Weekly Closing Range` >= 40,
    `EPS Rating` >= 70,
    `Market Cap (mil)` > 300
  )

# --- 6. PULLBACK TO 10SMA CONDITIONS -----------------------------------------
# Condition A: Pullback to 10SMA after 20-day high (RS line near new high)
condition_a <- base_filtered %>%
  filter(
    `Price vs 10-Day` >= -3.0,
    `Price vs 10-Day` <= 2.0,
    `Price vs 21-Day` > 2.0,
    (`RS Line New High` == "Yes" | `RS Line Within 5% of New High` == "Yes")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Setup = "A: PB to 10SMA after 20D High")

# Condition B: Pullback to 10SMA after 50% rally in last 3 months
condition_b <- base_filtered %>%
  filter(
    `Price vs 10-Day` >= -3.0,
    `Price vs 10-Day` <= 2.0,
    `% Chg 3 Months` >= 50,
    `Price vs 50-Day` > 10
  ) %>%
  mutate(Setup = "B: PB to 10SMA after 50% 3M Rally")

# Combine both setups
screened <- bind_rows(condition_a, condition_b) %>%
  distinct(Symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Setup = ifelse(
      Symbol %in% intersect(condition_a$Symbol, condition_b$Symbol),
      "A + B: Both Setups",
      Setup
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(`RS Rating`), desc(`Comp Rating`))

# --- 7. ADD THEME / SECTOR STRENGTH RANKING ----------------------------------
screened <- screened %>%
  left_join(
    sector_theme %>% select(Sector, Sector_RS_3M = Avg_RS_3M),
    by = "Sector"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Theme_Score = case_when(
      Sector_RS_3M >= 65 ~ "Hot",
      Sector_RS_3M >= 55 ~ "Warm",
      Sector_RS_3M >= 45 ~ "Neutral",
      TRUE ~ "Cold"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Sector_RS_3M), desc(`RS Rating`))

# --- 8. OUTPUT TABLES ---------------------------------------------------------

## 8a. Sector Theme Overview
cat("\n### Hot Sectors / Themes\n")
sector_theme %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Sector Momentum Rankings") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Avg_RS_3M, Avg_RS_6M, Avg_3M_Chg, Avg_YTD_Chg, Avg_vs200D), decimals = 1) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = Avg_RS_3M,
    colors = scales::col_numeric(
      palette = c("#d73027", "#fc8d59", "#fee08b", "#d9ef8b", "#91cf60", "#1a9850"),
      domain = c(0, 80)
    )
  )

## 8b. Screened Results — Summary
cat("\n### Screened Stocks: Pullback to 10SMA Setups\n")
cat(paste0("Total stocks passing all filters: **", nrow(screened), "**\n\n"))

if (nrow(screened) > 0) {
  
  # Summary by Sector
  summary_by_sector <- screened %>%
    group_by(Sector, Theme_Score) %>%
    summarise(
      Count = n(),
      Avg_RS = round(mean(`RS Rating`), 1),
      Avg_Comp = round(mean(`Comp Rating`), 1),
      Top_Symbol = Symbol[which.max(`RS Rating`)],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Count))
  
  summary_by_sector %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(title = "Setup Distribution by Sector") %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(Avg_RS, Avg_Comp), decimals = 1)
  
  # Detailed Results Table
  cat("\n### Detailed Stock List\n")
  
  detailed <- screened %>%
    select(
      Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, Setup, Theme_Score,
      `RS Rating`, `RS 3-Month Rating`, `Comp Rating`,
      `Current Price`, `Price vs 10-Day`, `Price vs 21-Day`,
      `Price vs 50-Day`, `Price vs 200-Day`, `% Off High`,
      `% Chg 3 Months`, `% Chg 6 Months`, `% Chg YTD`,
      `EPS Rating`, `EPS % Chg Last Qtr`, `EPS Est Cur Yr %`,
      `A/D Rating`, `Market Cap (mil)`, `Volume (1000s)`,
      `Ind Group Rank`, `RS Line New High`
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(`RS Rating`))
  
  detailed %>%
    mutate(
      `Market Cap (mil)` = round(`Market Cap (mil)` / 1000, 1),
      `Volume (1000s)` = comma(`Volume (1000s)`)
    ) %>%
    rename(`Mkt Cap (B)` = `Market Cap (mil)`) %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(
      title = "Pullback to 10SMA — High RS + Momentum Setups",
      subtitle = paste0("Data as of: ", unique(universe$timestamp))
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(
      columns = c(`RS Rating`, `RS 3-Month Rating`, `Comp Rating`, `EPS Rating`,
                  `Price vs 10-Day`, `Price vs 21-Day`, `Price vs 50-Day`, `Price vs 200-Day`,
                  `% Off High`, `% Chg 3 Months`, `% Chg 6 Months`, `% Chg YTD`,
                  `EPS % Chg Last Qtr`, `EPS Est Cur Yr %`, `Ind Group Rank`),
      decimals = 1
    ) %>%
    fmt_currency(columns = `Current Price`, decimals = 2) %>%
    data_color(
      columns = `RS Rating`,
      colors = scales::col_numeric(
        palette = c("#d73027", "#fc8d59", "#fee08b", "#d9ef8b", "#91cf60", "#1a9850"),
        domain = c(70, 99)
      )
    ) %>%
    data_color(
      columns = `% Chg 3 Months`,
      colors = scales::col_numeric(
        palette = c("#d73027", "#fc8d59", "#fee08b", "#d9ef8b", "#91cf60", "#1a9850"),
        domain = c(0, 100)
      )
    ) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(12),
      data_row.padding = px(4)
    )
    
} else {
  cat("**No stocks passed all filters.** Consider loosening:\n")
  cat("- Lower RS Rating threshold to 75\n")
  cat("- Widen `% Off High` to -20\n")
  cat("- Reduce `% Chg 3 Months` to 5\n")
  cat("- Allow A/D Rating down to 'C+'\n")
}


# --- 9. INTERACTIVE DATATABLE (Optional — for HTML output) -------------------
 screened %>%
   select(Symbol, Name, Sector, Setup, `RS Rating`, `Comp Rating`,
          `Current Price`, `% Chg 3 Months`, `% Off High`) %>%
   datatable(
     options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE),
     caption = "Pullback to 10SMA Setups"
   ) %>%
   formatPercentage("% Chg 3 Months", digits = 1) %>%
   formatCurrency("Current Price", digits = 2)

```
